project.name: oh-my-code
project.purpose: A friendly terminal-first code workbench for project navigation, editing, and local Git review.

workflow.remoteChecks: STRICT FOR HOSTED RELEASE; NOT APPLICABLE TO LOCAL PLAN

release.animation: one-second interactive-TTY ANSI splash with explicit disable controls

acceptedProductDirection.primaryWorkflow: terminal-first project navigation, editing, and bounded local Git review
acceptedProductDirection.layout: Files view: left lazy project tree plus right source preview; Diff view: left changed-file list plus middle old-file and right new-file panes
acceptedProductDirection.paneResize: mouse-draggable, width-constrained boundaries between visible panes
acceptedProductDirection.diffBaseline: working tree versus HEAD, including untracked files
acceptedProductDirection.gitMutationBoundary: File-level local stage/unstage and local staged commit only; no remote, checkout, history-rewrite, discard, amend, or partial-line operation

editorInteraction.previewEntry: Files view Space shows a read-only preview; opening a regular file loads its editable buffer in the right pane
editorInteraction.mouseSelection: Completed mouse selections in editable file buffers copy to the local system clipboard; preview and read-only Diff panes do not auto-copy
editorInteraction.escape: Esc returns directly from Insert, Normal, or Visual to the same file Preview; modified buffers require confirmation and are never silently saved or discarded
editorInteraction.statusline: Bottom editor hints explain mouse auto-copy and Esc Preview alongside copy, cut, paste, save, and undo

successorBrief.paneGeometry: Persist independent Files and Git Diff layouts across view switches and local workbench launches.
successorBrief.settingsInteraction: Use a visible selected-control cursor; Up/Down changes controls, Left/Right changes theme only on the theme control, Space activates the selected control, Esc closes, and a top-right mouse close control is visible.
successorBrief.sourceControl: Split the left Git area horizontally with current changes/status above and the full current-branch commit graph below, including merges; let the user choose two revision/location endpoints for a read-only comparison without checkout.
successorBrief.localGitWrites: File-level stage/unstage and local staged commit with a user-entered commit-message input; exclude push, pull, fetch, merge, rebase, checkout, discard, amend, remote synchronization, credentials, and partial-line staging.
